name: PGO Content Duplicator
author: Paolo Melotto

sections.description:
PGO Content Duplicator adds a consistent PGO Duplicate action to every supported WordPress content list. Every copy is created as a draft so it can be reviewed before publication.

Its safety-first workflow is designed for stores, editorial teams and sites that use custom post types: it deliberately avoids cloning identifiers, operational totals and order data that could make a copied item conflict with its source.

The plugin copies:

  • title, content and excerpt;
  • categories, tags and custom taxonomies;
  • compatible custom fields;
  • page hierarchy and menu order;
  • public custom post types with an administrative interface.

Sensitive or identity-related metadata is excluded. Orders, refunds, coupons, revisions, attachments and privacy requests cannot be duplicated. WooCommerce SKU, sales, ratings and stock values are not copied.

There is no tracking and the plugin does not contact external services. All functionality runs on the WordPress site.

FREE and PRO

The free plugin provides single and bulk draft duplication. PGO Content Duplicator PRO is a separate plugin sold on Plugingo.it and adds multiple copies, selectable status and suffix, controlled find-and-replace, hierarchical child duplication and an operation log.

The free version remains fully functional without a license. FREE and PRO are separate plugins and are not designed to be active at the same time.

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory and activate it.
  2. Open Posts, Pages, Products or a supported custom post type.
  3. Select PGO Duplicate below a content title, or use Duplicate as draft from bulk actions.
  4. Review the new draft before publishing it.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin publish copies automatically?

No. The free version always creates a draft and opens it for review.

Does it duplicate WooCommerce orders?

No. Orders, refunds, coupons and order-related content are explicitly blocked.

Does it copy a product SKU or stock quantity?

No. Unique identifiers, stock, sales and rating information are excluded to prevent unsafe duplicates.

Does it send data to Plugingo?

No. The free plugin does not transmit usage or site data and does not load remote assets.

Where can I get support?

Use the WordPress.org support forum for the directory version or visit the Plugingo documentation and support page linked above.

Is there a step-by-step video tutorial?

Yes. The video tutorial in the Description section demonstrates installation and the complete duplication workflow. English subtitles are available.
sections.changelog:
1.1.8

  • Ensured that activating FREE deactivates Content Duplicator PRO, preventing duplicate actions and conflicting workflows.

1.1.7

  • Updated the in-plugin instructions to clearly distinguish the “PGO Duplicate” row action from bulk duplication.

1.1.6

  • Added the consistently branded “PGO Duplicate” row action to posts, pages, WooCommerce products and compatible custom post types.
  • The Plugingo action remains distinct when WooCommerce or another plugin also provides its own Duplicate command.

1.1.5

  • Fixed bulk duplication by separating its action identifier from the single-item duplicate action.

1.1.4

  • Fixed the redirect after bulk duplication so submitted actions and expired nonces cannot be replayed.

1.1.3

  • Kept third-party WordPress admin notices above the Plugingo interface instead of allowing them inside the branded hero panel.
  • Preserved the visual heading hierarchy and accessibility with a dedicated screen-reader page title.

1.1.2

  • Replaced short internal identifiers with the unique pgocodu prefix.
  • Reviewed constants, action names, filter names, query parameters and asset handles for collision safety.
  • Retested single and bulk duplication on a clean WordPress installation.
  • Switched all interface source strings to English and made them translation-ready.
  • Added clear, contextual links to Content Duplicator PRO, support and Plugingo PASS.

1.1.1

  • Loaded the administration stylesheet through the WordPress enqueue API.
  • Removed automatic deactivation of the separate PRO plugin; plugin activation remains under user control.
  • Clarified the plugin’s safety-focused duplication workflow.

1.1.0

  • Prepared the plugin for the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  • Removed the external update mechanism; directory updates are handled by WordPress.org.
  • Added a contextual Plugingo help page and a restrained FREE/PRO comparison.
  • Excluded SKU, stock and additional WooCommerce identity metadata from copies.
  • Expanded privacy, installation and support documentation.
